_comment: THIS box's DS4.1-Flash config (4x MI50 32GB gfx906, 125 GiB RAM, ROCm 7.2.0), written 2026-10-22 BEFORE the first boot - the P4.0 (#18) twin of tools/glm/serve/strata-glm-mayal-gfx906.json. The authors' strata-ds41.json is left alone; THIS is the file P4.5 boots. Deliberate first-boot deltas from the authors' args, each to be re-added only after a green plain boot (change one thing at a time): no --prompt-batch (their 12288 is a 24G-card-tuned default and #19 hasn't sized ours), no --route-bias/--route-bias-file (first serve witness runs the exact path: STRATA_SERVE_STEP_MAX=96 + PASS_BIAS=0 are already the wrapper defaults), no --kv-fp4 (quality-adjacent, not needed to prove boot), DSpark OFF in ds41-engine-906.sh. --ctx 32768 and --arena-gib 64 are the authors' serve numbers as a starting point; P4.1 (#19, docs/gfx906/P4-RAM-BUDGET.md) sizes both against this box from the boot log. 512K is a P4b goal, NOT a first boot.
